title: Asking what an object is
explanation: Use ¿Qué es esto? to ask what an unknown object is. Answer with Es un... or Es una... The question asks for an object name, not a price.

title: esto, este and esta
explanation: At A0, use esto in the question ¿Qué es esto? Use este before a masculine noun and esta before a feminine noun when choosing an item: este libro, esta botella.

title: un and una with familiar objects
explanation: Use un with practiced masculine objects such as libro and cuaderno. Use una with practiced feminine objects such as botella, bolsa and llave. This module teaches only these familiar examples.

title: Polite availability question
explanation: In the shop role-play, use the polite fixed question ¿Tiene...? to ask whether the seller has an item. The seller may answer Sí, tenemos... or No, no tenemos.... This module does not teach the full tú/usted contrast.

title: Asking and stating a simple price
explanation: Use ¿Cuánto cuesta? to ask the price of one item. Answer with Cuesta... euros. For a simple total, Son... euros may also be used. The practiced prices are one, two, three, five and ten euros.

title: caro/cara and barato/barata
explanation: Use caro or barato with practiced masculine objects. Use cara or barata with practiced feminine objects. Keep the object and adjective together: el libro es caro, la bolsa es barata.

title: Basic purchase request
explanation: Use Quiero... for a simple purchase intention and Este/Esta, por favor to point to one item. Use Nada más, gracias to answer ¿Algo más? when you do not want anything else.
